subject: general
question: Which of the following is an autobiography of Sachin Tendulkar?
solution:
The correct answer is **Playing It My Way**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Playing It My Way"** is the autobiography of **Sachin Tendulkar**, a legendary cricketer from India.
 
• The book details **Tendulkar's personal journey** from a young boy with dreams of playing for his country to becoming one of the most celebrated cricketers in the world.
 
• It provides insights into **his early days**, personal life, career highlights, and the challenges he faced.
 
• The autobiography was **co-authored** by Sachin Tendulkar and **Boria Majumdar**, a renowned sports journalist and historian.
 
• It was **released** in November **2014**, setting records for publishing sales in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sachin Tendulkar** is considered one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He made his **Test debut** for India against Pakistan at the age of 16 in **1989**.
 
• Tendulkar has numerous records to his name, including the most runs in both **Test** and **ODI cricket**, and the only player to score **100 international centuries**.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **2014**, becoming the youngest recipient and the first sportsperson to receive the award.
